Axiom Systems How It Works Our Work Pricing Add-Ons FAQ Get Started

Legal

Privacy Policy

How Axiom Systems collects, uses and protects information when you visit our website, contact us or use our services.
Effective date: October 27, 2026

Overview

This Privacy Policy explains how Axiom Systems (“Axiom Systems,” “we,” “us” or “our”) collects, uses and shares information when you visit axiomsystems.systems (the “Website”), contact us, or use our services. Our services include website-as-a-service, web design, website hosting and maintenance, Google Ads management, lead capture, CRM automation, appointment scheduling, automated follow-ups and review request systems.

Our services are offered to businesses in the United States. By using the Website or contacting us, you acknowledge the practices described in this policy.

1. Information we collect

Information you provide. When you submit our Get Started form, we collect your name, business name, email address, phone number, current website address (optional), what you tell us about your business, and the plan or service you were viewing when you contacted us. When you use the chat widget on our Website, we collect the name, contact details and messages you enter. We also collect information you share when you call, text or email us.

Information from clients. If you become a client, we collect the business, billing and account information needed to provide our services, along with the content, images and other materials you give us for your website, campaigns and automations.

Information collected automatically. When you visit the Website, we and our service providers automatically collect technical information such as your IP address, browser and device type, the pages you view, the page that referred you, and the date and time of your visit. When you submit our form, your IP address and browser information are stored with your submission to help us prevent spam and abuse. See “Cookies and analytics” below.

Information from third parties. We may receive information from advertising platforms such as Google (for example, the details you submit in a Google Ads lead form, or information about which ad led to your visit) and from people who refer you to us.

2. How we use information

We use the information we collect to respond to your inquiries and questions; to schedule and confirm consultations and appointments; to provide, manage and support our services; to manage our client relationships, including billing and account communications; to send marketing communications where permitted by law or where you have agreed to receive them; to measure and improve our Website and our advertising; to protect our Website, our business and our users against spam, fraud and abuse; and to comply with legal obligations and enforce our agreements.

3. Google Ads and lead forms

We advertise our services with Google Ads. When you visit our Website after clicking one of our ads, Google may use cookies to measure the ad’s performance. When you successfully submit our Get Started form, our Website reports a conversion to Google Ads so we can see which ads produce inquiries. This report contains a reference number for the submission; it does not include the answers you entered in the form.

If we run ads that include a Google lead form and you submit it, Google provides the information you enter (such as your name, email address and phone number) to us so we can respond to your request, and we add it to our CRM. Google’s collection and use of information is governed by the Google Privacy Policy.

4. CRM and automation

Inquiries from our Get Started form are saved on our Website, emailed to our team, and transferred to our customer relationship management (CRM) system, which is built on the GoHighLevel (LeadConnector) platform. Conversations started in our chat widget are handled in the same CRM. In the CRM we keep your contact details, notes about your inquiry, the status of your inquiry in our sales process, appointments, and the history of our communications with you.

We use automations in the CRM to respond to new inquiries, send follow-up messages, send appointment confirmations and reminders, and, for clients who have used our services, send requests to review our business.

Information we handle for our clients. When we build or manage websites, CRMs, automations or advertising for a client, we may process information about that client’s own customers and leads on the client’s behalf and according to the client’s instructions. The client is responsible for its own privacy notices and for obtaining any consent required for its communications. Questions about that information should be directed to the client.

5. Text messages (SMS)

How consent is obtained. When you give us your mobile phone number and ask us to contact you, for example through our Get Started form, our chat widget, or by texting or calling us, you agree that Axiom Systems may send you text messages related to your request. We send marketing text messages only to people who have agreed to receive them. Consent to receive marketing text messages is not a condition of purchasing any service.

Messages we send. Text messages may include responses to your inquiry, follow-up about the services you asked about, scheduling, appointment confirmations and reminders, and, for clients, service and account updates. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply.

Opting out and help. You can opt out at any time by replying STOP to any message. After you opt out, you may receive one message confirming your request, and we will not send further text messages unless you opt in again. Reply HELP for help, or call us at (727) 591-7527. Wireless carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

No sharing of mobile information. We do not sell, rent or share mobile phone numbers, SMS opt-in information or SMS consent with third parties or affiliates for their own marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties, except service providers that help us deliver messages on our behalf.

6. Email

We send emails to respond to your inquiry, schedule appointments and provide our services. If we send you marketing emails, you can unsubscribe at any time using the link in the email or by contacting us. If you are a client, we may continue to send service and account emails while you use our services.

7. Cookies and analytics

Our Website uses cookies and similar technologies, including:

Google Analytics, to understand how visitors use our Website.
Google Ads conversion tracking, to measure whether our ads lead to inquiries.
Jetpack Stats and WooCommerce Analytics (Automattic), for website statistics.
WooCommerce visitor-source cookies, which record how you arrived at our Website (for example, a search engine, referral or campaign link).
Security cookies set through our hosting provider’s network (Cloudflare) to distinguish people from automated traffic.
Our LeadConnector chat widget, which may store information in your browser to keep your chat session working.
Google Fonts, which loads our typefaces from Google’s servers.

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings; some features may not work as intended if you do. You can manage Google ad personalization in Google’s Ad Settings and opt out of Google Analytics with the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on. For visitors in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland, our Google tags use Google Consent Mode, which by default does not use advertising or analytics cookies until consent is given. Our Website does not currently respond to “Do Not Track” browser signals.

8. Service providers and sharing

We do not sell your personal information for money. We share information only as described in this policy, including with service providers that process it on our behalf and under their own privacy and security obligations: our website hosting provider (Kinsta, delivered through Cloudflare’s network); our website platform and its plugins (WordPress, and Jetpack by Automattic for forms and statistics); our CRM and communications platform (GoHighLevel / LeadConnector) and the telecommunications and email providers used to deliver our messages; our business email provider; Google (Analytics, Ads and Fonts); and the payment processors we use to bill clients.

We may also disclose information when required by law or legal process; to protect the rights, property and safety of Axiom Systems, our clients or others; in connection with a merger, acquisition or sale of all or part of our business; or with your direction or consent.

9. Data retention and security

We keep personal information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, including responding to your inquiry, providing our services, maintaining business records, complying with legal, tax and accounting obligations, resolving disputes, and keeping records of consent and opt-out requests. When information is no longer needed, we delete it or keep it in a form that no longer identifies you.

We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards designed to protect personal information, such as encrypted (HTTPS) connections to our Website and limiting access to the people and service providers who need it. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

10. Your privacy rights

Depending on where you live and the laws that apply to us, you may have the right to request access to the personal information we hold about you, to correct it, to delete it, to receive a copy of it, or to opt out of certain uses, such as targeted advertising. You can always opt out of marketing messages as described above.

To make a request, contact us using the details below. We will verify your request and respond as required by applicable law. We will not discriminate against you for exercising your privacy rights.

11. Children’s privacy

Our Website and services are intended for businesses and adults. They are not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will delete it.

12. Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will post the updated policy on this page and change the effective date above. If we make material changes, we will provide additional notice, such as a notice on our Website or an email to clients.

13. Contact us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to exercise your privacy rights, contact us:

Axiom Systems
Website: axiomsystems.systems
Phone: (727) 591-7527
Email: axiom.systems.co@gmail.com

Meet the artists

Three of the artists tattooing at Myrtle Beach Ink, each with their own style. Find the one whose work fits your idea, or ask the studio to match you.

01  ·  Owner & artist

Eddie Kane

Eddie owns and runs Myrtle Beach Ink. His focus is large-scale black and grey realism and portraits: faces, eyes and detail that reads from across the room.

Black & grey realism Portraits Large scale Consult with Eddie View portfolio ↗ 02  ·  Artist

Black & grey realism Illustrative Bold linework Fine line Custom Consult with Michael View portfolio ↗ 03  ·  Artist

Illustrative Black & grey Color Bold linework Fine line Custom Consult with Brian View portfolio ↗

The studio

On Seaboard
Street.

A clean, welcoming, professional studio where every client should walk away with a piece they love. Small fine-line work, custom lettering, portraits, matching tattoos and large-scale projects all start here.

Guest artists from other studios rotate through regularly.

Address

704 Seaboard Street, Unit A
Myrtle Beach, SC 29577

Get directions ↗ Call 843-626-8282 Email myrtlebeachink@yahoo.com Hours

Call the studio for current hours and availability.

Good to know

Real work.
Straight answers.

Every piece on this page comes from the artists' own portfolios. If a question isn't answered here, the studio is a call or email away.

Call 843-626-8282 Email the studio

How do I book?

+

Email myrtlebeachink@yahoo.com or call 843-626-8282 with your idea. For larger projects, or if you want a set date and time, an appointment is recommended.

Can I walk in?

+

Walk-ins are welcome on a first-come, first-served basis. Call ahead to check availability, especially if you are traveling. Please call rather than email for same-day requests.

What styles do you tattoo?

+

The studio takes on all tattoo styles, from small fine-line pieces and custom lettering to portraits, matching tattoos and large-scale work. The artist profiles above show each artist's specialties.

How much will my tattoo cost?

+

It depends on the piece. Share your idea, size and placement, and let the studio know if you have a budget in mind.

What about deposits, ID and other policies?

+

Contact the studio directly for current policies before your appointment.

Your next piece

Got an idea?
Let's make it yours.

Tell us what you have in mind, even if it's only the start of an idea. Name an artist if you already know whose work you want, or leave it open.

Ready now? Reach the studio directly.

Our story

A South Carolina
Original.

For over a decade, Myrtle Beach Ink has served locals and visitors in a clean, welcoming, professional environment. It was the first legalized tattoo studio in South Carolina, and it is the officially recognized tattoo shop of Myrtle Beach.

The studio is owned and operated by multi-award-winning artist Eddie Kane, who sets the standard for every piece that leaves the chair. From fine line and custom lettering to portraits, matching tattoos and large-scale custom work, the aim is simple: a tattoo you love and an experience you remember.

Award winner Best of the Beach Year after year.

The studio

On Seaboard
Street.

A clean, welcoming, professional studio where every client should walk away with a piece they love. Small fine-line work, custom lettering, portraits, matching tattoos and large-scale projects all start here.

+

Email myrtlebeachink@yahoo.com or call 843-626-8282 with your idea. For larger projects, or if you want a set date and time, an appointment is recommended.

Can I walk in?
+

Walk-ins are welcome on a first-come, first-served basis. Call ahead to check availability, especially if you are traveling. Please call rather than email for same-day requests.

What styles do you tattoo?
+

The studio takes on all tattoo styles, from small fine-line pieces and custom lettering to portraits, matching tattoos and large-scale work. The artist profiles above show each artist's specialties.

How much will my tattoo cost?
+

It depends on the piece. Share your idea, size and placement, and let the studio know if you have a budget in mind.

+

Is there a setup fee or a contract?

I already have a website. Can you help?

Yes. We'll design a new site for your business and bring over the content that's worth keeping, so you're not starting from zero.

It depends on the size of your site and how quickly we get your content and feedback. We'll give you a realistic timeline once we've reviewed your business.

Axiom Systems How It Works Our Work Pricing Add-Ons FAQ Get Started

FAQ

Questions? We've got answers.

Straight answers about pricing, what's included and how it works, so you know exactly what you're signing up for.

PRICING & BILLING

How much does it cost?

Axiom Essential is $299 a month and Axiom Growth is $599 a month, both with a $0 setup fee. Axiom Marketing starts at $1,500 a month, plus advertising spend that you pay directly; a custom setup fee may apply depending on complexity. Submitting the Get Started form doesn't charge you anything: we'll guide you through the next steps first.

Is there really no setup fee?

Really, for Axiom Essential and Axiom Growth. There's no separate charge for designing or building your website; you simply pay your monthly plan. Axiom Marketing may include a custom setup fee depending on campaign complexity, and we'll tell you before you sign.

Can I cancel anytime?

Axiom Essential is a monthly subscription you can cancel anytime. Axiom Growth has no long-term contract: you can cancel anytime with 30 days' written notice. Axiom Marketing starts with an initial three-month agreement, and its renewal and cancellation terms are shared before you sign.

Why is it monthly instead of one big website payment?

Because a website isn't finished the day it launches. It needs hosting, security, software updates and changes as your business grows. Instead of charging thousands upfront and leaving all of that to you, we build your website and then keep hosting, maintaining, updating and supporting it for one monthly price.

WHAT'S INCLUDED

What's included in Axiom Essential?

A professionally designed, conversion-focused website that works on phones, plus managed hosting, SSL and security, maintenance and updates, backups, on-page SEO fundamentals, contact forms, analytics, ongoing support, instant acknowledgment of website inquiries and FREE automated Google review requests. Automation features are available upon activation.

Can you update my website after it launches?

Yes. Standard updates are part of the service, like changing text, photos, hours, services or contact details. Bigger projects, like a complete redesign or new custom features, go beyond standard updates, and we'll talk those through with you first.

Will my website work on phones?

Yes. Every Axiom website is built to work on phones, tablets and computers. Most of your customers will see it on a phone first, so we design with that in mind.

Do you handle hosting, security and backups?

Yes. Managed hosting, SSL, security, software updates and regular backups are all included. You don't need to buy or manage any of it yourself.

Can you help with Google and local search?

Every website is built with local-search fundamentals: a clean structure, mobile-friendly pages and clear information about your services and service area. Nobody can honestly guarantee rankings, and we don't, but your site starts on a solid foundation.

Can you connect forms, reviews or booking tools?

Usually, yes. Contact and lead forms are included, and we can bring in things like your reviews or an existing booking tool when it makes sense for your business. Every platform is different, so we'll confirm what's possible for your setup.

Do you offer more than websites?

Yes. Axiom Growth ($599/month) is our complete business system: your website plus Axiom CRM, missed-call text-back, automated lead follow-up, a sales pipeline and appointment reminders. FAQ

Questions?
We've got answers.

Straight answers about pricing, what's included and how it works, so you know exactly what you're signing up for.

Pricing & billing

How much does it cost?

Axiom Essential is $299 a month and Axiom Growth is $599 a month, both with a $0 setup fee. Axiom Marketing starts at $1,500 a month, plus advertising spend that you pay directly; a custom setup fee may apply depending on complexity. Submitting the Get Started form doesn't charge you anything: we'll guide you through the next steps first.

Is there really no setup fee?

Really, for Axiom Essential and Axiom Growth. There's no separate charge for designing or building your website; you simply pay your monthly plan. Axiom Marketing may include a custom setup fee depending on campaign complexity, and we'll tell you before you sign.

Can I cancel anytime?

Axiom Essential is a monthly subscription you can cancel anytime. Axiom Growth has no long-term contract: you can cancel anytime with 30 days' written notice. Axiom Marketing starts with an initial three-month agreement, and its renewal and cancellation terms are shared before you sign.

Why is it monthly instead of one big website payment?

Because a website isn't finished the day it launches. It needs hosting, security, software updates and changes as your business grows. Instead of charging thousands upfront and leaving all of that to you, we build your website and then keep hosting, maintaining, updating and supporting it for one monthly price.

What's included

What's included in Axiom Essential?

A professionally designed, conversion-focused website that works on phones, plus managed hosting, SSL and security, maintenance and updates, backups, on-page SEO fundamentals, contact forms, analytics, ongoing support, instant acknowledgment of website inquiries and FREE automated Google review requests. Automation features are available upon activation.

Can you update my website after it launches?

Yes. Standard updates are part of the service, like changing text, photos, hours, services or contact details. Bigger projects, like a complete redesign or new custom features, go beyond standard updates, and we'll talk those through with you first.

Will my website work on phones?

Yes. Every Axiom website is built to work on phones, tablets and computers. Most of your customers will see it on a phone first, so we design with that in mind.

Do you handle hosting, security and backups?

Yes. Managed hosting, SSL, security, software updates and regular backups are all included. You don't need to buy or manage any of it yourself.

Can you help with Google and local search?

Every website is built with local-search fundamentals: a clean structure, mobile-friendly pages and clear information about your services and service area. Nobody can honestly guarantee rankings, and we don't, but your site starts on a solid foundation.

Axiom Systems How It Works Our Work Pricing Add-Ons FAQ Get Started

ADD-ONS

Build the system your business needs.

Every Axiom website plan includes free Google review requests. Add Lead Automation when you're ready, or get one connected system with Axiom Growth.

Compare plans →

Google Review Requests

Turn Great Service Into a Stronger Reputation.

Make it easier for customers to share their experience. Every Axiom website plan includes simple, automated Google review invitations to help your business build a stronger online reputation.

Neutral Google review invitations

Standardized email workflow or limited SMS

Available upon activation

Explore Website Plans →

Axiom Lead Automation

+$349/month

Never Miss an Opportunity.

Your business doesn't stop when you're busy. Axiom Lead Automation responds to incoming inquiries, recovers missed calls, and automatically follows up with potential customers, helping you turn more opportunities into booked jobs.

Missed-call text-back

Instant lead response

Automated SMS & email follow-up

Lead notifications

Lead nurturing

Basic CRM & pipeline management

Add Lead Automation →

Axiom Lead Automation is a managed service, $349/month in addition to your $299/month Axiom Essential plan. It's included with Axiom Growth, so you're never charged twice. Automation features are available upon activation and subject to reasonable usage limits and applicable consent requirements. Review requests are neutral; reviews and ratings are never guaranteed. Axiom CRM is our branded, managed setup of an established third-party CRM platform.

One Connected System. Built to Grow Your Business.

Your website, customer inquiries, and follow-ups working together. Axiom Growth combines professional website management with powerful business automations so fewer opportunities slip away and more leads become paying customers.

Axiom Growth: $599/month. Axiom Essential ($299) + Axiom Lead Automation ($349) = $648/month purchased separately. Growth also includes features not available in the Lead Automation add-on. Save $49/month.

Grow My Business

Professional, conversion-focused website

Hosting & ongoing management

Mobile-responsive design

Maintenance & updates

On-page SEO fundamentals

FREE Google review requests

Instant inquiry acknowledgment

Axiom CRM

Missed-call text-back

Automated SMS & email follow-up

Lead pipeline management

Appointment confirmations & reminders

Estimate & quote follow-up

Lead conversion tracking & reporting

PREMIUM ADVERTISING · AXIOM MARKETING

More Leads. Better Opportunities. Real Growth.

Take your business beyond a great website. Axiom Marketing combines strategic Google advertising, conversion-focused landing pages, and hands-on campaign management to help turn qualified traffic into real customer opportunities.

Starting at

$1,500

/month

Ad spend paid separately

Keep your existing website

Get More Leads

ACTIVELY MANAGED ADVERTISING

Google Ads strategy & management

Continuous campaign monitoring & optimization

Conversion-focused landing pages

Lead tracking & performance reporting

AUTOMATION · AVAILABLE UPON ACTIVATION

Axiom CRM lead tracking

Automated lead follow-up

Available independently. No Axiom website plan required: Marketing works with the website you already have. Axiom Growth manages your website and follow-up; Axiom Marketing actively brings in new leads. Choose either, or pair them.

Advertising spend is billed separately and paid directly by you. Lead tracking and follow-up are included as described above, within your agreed service scope. Custom setup fees may apply. Initial three-month agreement; renewal and cancellation terms are shared before you sign. Results vary; we don't guarantee lead volume, ad performance or rankings.

EVERY SERVICE

What's included where.

A quick map of our services, so you never pay twice for the same feature.

Ask us →

GET STARTED

Let's find the right plan.

Start with Axiom Essential, add what you need, or talk to us about Growth or Marketing. We'll recommend the right fit.

Plans from $299/month · Submit your business details and we'll guide you through the next steps.

Tell us about your business

A few lines is plenty: your business name, what you do and where. We'll review it and reach out personally with the next step.

Get Started

Or write to us directly at axiom.systems.co@gmail.com

Axiom Systems How It Works Our Work Pricing Add-Ons FAQ Get Started

PRICING

Plans that grow with your business.

Start with a professionally managed website. Add Axiom CRM and automated follow-up, or bring in new leads with Google Ads, when your business is ready. Every plan builds on the same connected system.

INCLUDED WITH EVERY AXIOM WEBSITE

FREE automated Google review follow-ups

Every Axiom website plan includes simple, automated Google review invitations to help your business build a stronger online reputation.

Available upon activation.

AXIOM ESSENTIAL

$299

/month

$0 setup fee

Cancel anytime

A conversion-focused website, built and managed for you, with Google review requests and instant inquiry replies included.

YOUR WEBSITE

Professional, conversion-focused website

Hosting & ongoing website management

Mobile-responsive design

Website maintenance & updates

On-page SEO fundamentals

INCLUDED AUTOMATION · AVAILABLE UPON ACTIVATION

FREE automated Google review requests

Instant acknowledgment of website inquiries

Get Started

AXIOM GROWTH

Recommended

$599

/month

$0 setup fee

No long-term contract

Our complete business system. Your website, Axiom CRM, missed-call recovery and automated follow-up work together, so fewer leads slip away and more inquiries become paying customers.

EVERYTHING IN ESSENTIAL, PLUS · AVAILABLE UPON ACTIVATION

Axiom CRM: leads, conversations & pipeline in one place

Missed-call text-back to recover lost calls

Automated multi-step SMS & email follow-up

Pipeline from new lead to paying customer

Appointment confirmations & reminders

Estimate & quote follow-up

Lead conversion tracking & reporting

Built for businesses that already get calls and inquiries and want to respond faster, follow up consistently and win more of them. No long-term contract: cancel anytime with 30 days' written notice.

Grow My Business

AXIOM MARKETING

Starting at

$1,500

/month

Ad spend paid separately

Bring in new leads with Google Ads, then capture and follow up with them automatically, so more of your ad spend turns into real customer conversations.

LEAD GENERATION

Google Ads campaign strategy & management

Conversion-focused landing pages

Lead tracking & attribution

Campaign optimization

Monthly performance reporting

Ongoing marketing strategy

AUTOMATION · AVAILABLE UPON ACTIVATION

Axiom CRM lead tracking

Automated lead follow-up

Works with your existing website. Advertising spend is paid directly by you. A custom setup fee may apply. Initial three-month agreement; renewal and cancellation terms are shared before you sign.

Get More Leads

Review requests are neutral invitations; reviews and ratings are never guaranteed. All automated messaging is subject to reasonable usage limits and applicable consent requirements. Custom booking-software integrations and high-volume messaging are not included. Axiom CRM is our branded, managed setup of an established third-party CRM platform. Questions first? Email axiom.systems.co@gmail.com

Why there's no big website bill.

You pay monthly, not upfront.

Custom websites usually start with a large invoice. With Axiom, your website is part of a monthly plan instead, starting at $299 a month with no setup fee.

We keep it running.

Hosting, security, updates, backups and support are all part of the monthly price, so your site doesn't go stale after launch.

What's yours stays yours.

Your business, domain, brand, logo, customer data and the content you give us are always yours. The website build and design are provided by Axiom as part of your active subscription.

Explore Add-Ons →

GET STARTED

Let's find the right plan.

Tell us about your business and what you want your website, follow-up and marketing to do. We'll recommend a plan and answer every question before you sign up.

Plans from $299/month · Submit your business details and we'll guide you through the next steps.

Tell us about your business

A few lines is plenty: your business name, what you do and where. We'll review it and reach out personally with the next step.

Get Started

Or write to us directly at axiom.systems.co@gmail.com

Axiom Systems How It Works Our Work Pricing Add-Ons FAQ Get Started

OUR WORK

The work is the pitch.

Every site here is live.

A pressure washing and coatings company in Pinellas County. A custom tile contractor in Tampa Bay. Two jet ski tour operators on Florida's Gulf Coast. Real businesses with real customers, and websites you can open and use right now.

What would yours look like? ↓ 01 Brags Global Pressure washing & coatings · Pinellas County ↓ 02 Xtreme Jet Ski Watersports Guided jet ski tours · St. Petersburg ↓ 03 Aqua Safari Jet Ski Adventures jetskiadventureclearwater.com · Tarpon Springs ↓ 04 The Tile Father Custom tile · Tampa Bay ↓

LOCAL SERVICE BUSINESS

Brags Global

The first screen does the selling: every service listed, quote and call buttons, and the trust signals customers look for before they pick up the phone.

Brags Global cleans, coats and refinishes concrete for homes and businesses across Pinellas County. Pressure washing, epoxy and flake floors, stains and protective coatings.

Six different services had to make sense at a glance. And asking for a price had to take one tap, whether a customer wants to call, text or send a request.

A dark, confident site with the full service list on the first screen, a photo card for every service, a simple three-step process and quote buttons throughout. Licensed & Insured and Locally Owned sit right under the headline.

Local service business · Call, text or request a quote · Residential & commercial

Visit the live site ↗

TOURS & EXPERIENCES

Xtreme Jet Ski Watersports

Xtreme takes riders out of St. Petersburg on guided jet ski expeditions to sandbars, hidden islands and dolphin spots, with Captain Mike leading the way.

Someone looking at a jet ski tour wants three answers fast: are you open, is there a spot, and how do I book? The site had to answer all three before anyone scrolls.

A bright, high-energy site over a full-screen water backdrop. Opening hours, Check Availability & Book and Call Now come first, then Captain Mike's guided expedition, then Google reviews. Tours, boating license info and FAQs are one click away.

Hours, booking and a call button, all on the first screen.

The guided expedition gets its own spotlight, sold by the captain who leads it, with a button that books the 2-hour tour directly.

Tours & experiences · Online booking · Google reviews on the homepage

Visit the live site ↗

NOT A TEMPLATE

Same industry. Same coast. Look again.

Xtreme and Aqua Safari both take people out on guided jet ski tours along Florida's Gulf Coast. On paper, they're the same kind of business. Here's how differently their websites introduce them.

A rounded, glowing all-caps wordmark

Towering condensed capitals

Open Daily, Check Availability & Book, Call Now

“Clearwater Jet Ski Adventures Beyond the Ordinary”

Captain Mike's guided expeditions

The islands: Three Rooker and Anclote Key

Google reviews right on the homepage

Real photos from their own tours and a meet-the-owner intro

Neither site could be swapped for the other.

That's the point.

TOURS & EXPERIENCES

Aqua Safari Jet Ski Adventures

Aqua Safari takes riders across the Gulf from Tarpon Springs to Three Rooker Island and Anclote Key. Its website had one job: make a first-timer want the trip, then get them booked.

An adventure site that sells the islands

Built to sell the destination, not just the ride. Huge condensed headlines, photography from Aqua Safari's own tours, an introduction to the owner and guide, and a straight answer to “how far is it from Clearwater Beach?”

Dedicated sections for Three Rooker Island and Anclote Key

Book buttons throughout, connected to live online booking

First-timer questions answered before anyone has to call

Visit the live site ↗

SKILLED TRADES · CUSTOM TILE

The Tile Father

Axiom Systems How It Works Our Work Pricing Add-Ons FAQ Get Started

HOW WEBSITE AS A SERVICE WORKS

We build it. We launch it.

Then we keep taking care of it.

Axiom designs and builds a custom website for your business, puts it live, and then stays on as the team responsible for it. Here's exactly what happens, from our first conversation to every month after launch.

Start my website See the four stages

Stages 01 to 03 get you live. Stage 04 is what your monthly plan is for.

THE PROCESS

Four stages. The last one keeps going.

Most website projects end at launch. With Axiom, launch is where the ongoing part of the relationship begins. Here's what happens at each stage, and what we'll need from you.

Tell us about your business

It starts with a conversation, not a pile of forms. We'll ask what you do, who your customers are, where you work and what you want people to do when they find you: call, request a quote, book or stop by.

Listen first and ask the right questions

Look at your current website, if you have one

Walk you through your site's scope and our terms before any work begins

Your business name, services and service area

Your logo and photos of your work, if you have them

How you want customers to reach you

A little of your time to answer questions

No logo or good photos yet? That's common. We'll talk it through together.

We design and build your website

We design a custom site around your business: your services, your photos, your service area and the way you talk to customers. Not a template with your name swapped in.

A custom design that fits your brand

Pages that look and work great on phones

Tap-to-call buttons and contact forms

Your services and service area laid out clearly

Local-search fundamentals built in

Your part: answer questions as they come up. Nothing technical.

A recent Axiom build: custom design, clear services, quote and call buttons up front.

We refine it with you, then launch

You review a working version of your website on your own phone and computer, not a sketch. Tell us what you'd like changed in plain words and we'll refine it together. When you're happy with it, we take it live.

You see the real site before your customers do

Point out anything that doesn't feel right

No design or technical vocabulary needed

We make the changes and walk you through them

Hosting set up and ready

Your website connected and taken live

Forms and call buttons tested

Checked on phones, tablets and computers

We keep managing it

This is what makes Website as a Service different. Launch isn't the finish line, and you don't get handed a login and a goodbye. Axiom stays responsible for your website, month after month.

Your website lives on secure, managed hosting. We set it up and keep watch over it.

The software behind your site needs regular updates. We install them and make sure nothing breaks.

We keep your site protected, so it stays safe and trustworthy for your customers.

Regular backups, so your site can be restored if something ever goes wrong.

New service, new photos, new hours? Tell us what changed and we'll update your website.

Something not looking right? You reach the people who built your site and know it.

AFTER LAUNCH

You run your business. We handle the website.

Once your site is live, here's how the work splits. Almost all of it lands on our side. That's the whole point.

Things you won't have to deal with

Finding, setting up and managing website hosting

Installing software updates and hoping nothing breaks

Wondering whether your website is backed up

Figuring out why a page or form stopped working

Learning website software just to change a phone number

Chasing a freelancer who stopped answering

What we'll ask of you

Tell us when something in your business changes

Send new photos or details when you have them

Let us know if something doesn't look right

Answer the calls and quote requests

That's it. No website logins to remember, no software to learn.

Need something updated? Just ask.

WHY MONTHLY?

You're not paying off a website. You're paying to have it managed.

A one-time website is finished the day it launches. After that, software goes out of date, your business changes and problems land on you. Your monthly plan keeps a team responsible for your website the whole time you're with us.

Websites need ongoing care

Updates, security and backups don't stop after launch. Someone has to handle them. With Axiom, that's us.

Your business keeps changing

New services, photos, prices or hours. Your website keeps up, without you having to learn how to edit it.

One price for all of it

Instead of separate bills for a designer, a host and whoever fixes things when they break, it's one plan: $299 a month.

GET STARTED

Ready to hand off your website?

Tell us a little about your business. We'll talk through what your website needs, answer every question and show you what's possible before you commit to anything.

Tell us about your business

A few lines is plenty: your business name, what you do and where. We'll review it and reach out personally with the next step.

Get Started See our work first

Or write to us directly at axiom.systems.co@gmail.com

Websites for Local Service Businesses

Websites built to turn visitors into calls and bookings.

Professional website builds for operators who need results, not just a digital business card. Request a Website Quote FEATURED PRODUCTION LAUNCH

Engineered for Local Dominance

Discover how we built a highly responsive, lightning-fast digital platform that drives continuous quote requests.

CASE STUDY

Brags Global Pressure Washing

A professional website presenting pressure washing and concrete coating services with clear calls to action for calls and quote requests.

  • Instant multi-tier booking forms
  • Geo-targeted localized SEO framework
  • Ultra-fast optimized assets & content delivery
Mobile Speed 0 % Inbound Leads + 0 % Visit Live Website bragspressurewashing.com OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

Built for Real Operations

Clear Service Pages

We make it incredibly easy for customers to understand exactly what you do. Beautifully structured layouts explain your rentals, charters, and operations without any friction.

Strong Calls to Action

Turn casual web visitors into scheduled bookings. Highly visible click-to-call buttons, instant quote triggers, and booking calendar integrations capture intent immediately.

Mobile-Friendly Design

Ensuring your platform works flawlessly whether you are sitting at a desk, out on the water, or coordinating gear in the field. Lightning fast and completely responsive. OPERATOR STORY

Built by a Real Operator

I’m Michael Hinkle. I don’t just build websites; I run a watersports business in Florida. I understand the friction of missed calls and confusing booking flows because I live it every day. Axiom is the result of building what I needed for my own operations.

Meet the Founder COMPLETE CARE PLAN

Ongoing Website Management

A high-performing website requires continuous optimization. Our dedicated management framework keeps your systems secure, blazing fast, and perfectly aligned with your evolving business operations.

Get Started Today PREMIUM SUITE

$299

Starts at $299/month after launch

  • Hosting
  • Routine Maintenance
  • Backups
  • Security Updates
  • Content Edit Allowance
Final scope defined in each proposal. OUR PROCESS

Three Steps to a High-Converting Vessel

A simplified, systematic roadmap engineered to audit your booking flows, design an elite modern platform, and fully manage the technical horizon.

01

Diagnosis

We audit your current setup. From technical performance bottlenecks to checkout conversion drop-offs, we reveal the critical friction points in your funnel.

02

Build

We create your conversion-focused site. Engineered with highly polished brand aesthetics, optimized speed architecture, and responsive booking flows.

03

Launch & Manage

We handle the tech so you can run your business. Enjoy complete peace of mind with continuous hosting monitoring, security patching, and core updates.

Book Your Setup Diagnosis

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our high-performance website builds and pricing plans.

What is included in the $299 plan?

Our $299 plan is a comprehensive starter package featuring a fully responsive custom layout, fast secure hosting setup, standard search engine optimization (SEO), and conversion-optimized contact forms to turn visitors into leads immediately.

Do I need to buy ads?

No, you do not need to buy paid advertising. Every page is built with solid on-page SEO frameworks to help your business gain traction organically, although targeted campaigns can be added to fast-track your lead pipeline.

How long does a build take?

Most standard builds are finalized and ready for launch within 2 to 4 weeks. This timeline relies heavily on prompt asset delivery, text feedback, and dynamic content approval.

Who owns the website?

You retain 100% full ownership of your finished website, including all copy, graphic design components, domains, and content assets. We believe in strict client freedom and independence.

  • No Obligations
  • Tailored Strategy

Let’s Talk About Your Growth

If you’re ready to bring structure, automation, and predictable revenue into your business, start here.

Every Axiom engagement begins with a Revenue Systems Audit — not a sales call.

content.raw:
Built by a Real Operator

Axiom Systems was founded by Michael Hinkle, a lifelong entrepreneur with more than 15 years of experience across sales, customer service, marketing, and business operations.

Long before Axiom existed, Michael was building businesses from the ground up — designing websites, managing advertising, building sales funnels, handling customers, and developing the systems behind them.

The goal was always the same:

Turn attention into revenue — and build a business that doesn't let opportunities fall through the cracks.

Today, Michael owns and operates Xtreme Jet Ski Watersports, a six-figure Florida watersports company competing in one of the most competitive tourism markets in the country.

The business doesn't run on theory.

Paid traffic has to produce bookings.
Calls have to get answered.
Leads have to get followed up with.
Customers have to move from interest to checkout.
And every advertising dollar has to earn its place.

The systems that make that possible became the foundation for Axiom Systems.

We built it for ourselves first. Now we build it for other operators.

Built in the Real World

Axiom wasn't created in a conference room.

It was built behind the scenes of real businesses — where missed calls mean lost revenue, wasted ad spend comes directly out of the owner's pocket, and a broken booking process can cost thousands of dollars.

Our experience spans:

  • High-pressure sales and closing

  • Customer experience and retention

  • Paid customer acquisition

  • Automotive and marine lead generation

  • High-ticket experience marketing

  • Conversion-focused websites and landing pages

  • CRM and follow-up automation

  • Booking and revenue optimization

That combination matters.

Plenty of agencies understand impressions, clicks, and cost per lead.

We understand what happens after the lead comes in.

Axiom was built by an operator who lives on the other side of the checkout button.

Why Axiom Exists

Running our own companies exposed a problem we saw again and again:

Great businesses were generating demand — and still leaving revenue on the table.

The problem wasn't always the advertising.

It was everything between the click and the customer.

Leads weren't tracked.
Calls were missed.
Follow-up was inconsistent.
Booking processes created friction.
Past prospects disappeared.
Owners had no clear picture of which marketing actually produced revenue.

Businesses didn't need another disconnected marketing tactic.

They needed the entire system to work together.

That's why Axiom Systems was created.

We connect acquisition, conversion, follow-up, booking, automation, and tracking into a single revenue system designed around one outcome:

More booked customers.

Beyond the Traditional Marketing Agency

Axiom Systems was built to go beyond traditional marketing.

We don't stop at delivering clicks, impressions, or leads.

We build the infrastructure that turns demand into measurable revenue.

That can include:

Paid Advertising → Landing Pages → Lead Capture → CRM → AI & Automated Follow-Up → Booking → Revenue Tracking

Every component has a purpose.

Every handoff matters.

And the system is measured by what ultimately matters to the operator:

Did it produce business?

We build and operate many of these same systems inside our own companies every day. That gives us a perspective most traditional agencies never get.

We know what it's like when the phone doesn't ring.

We know what it's like when advertising costs increase.

We know what it's like when a customer abandons a booking.

And we know what it's like when the system works and demand turns into predictable revenue.

We're not watching from the sidelines.

We're operators too.

From Clicks to Customers

The difference is simple:

Traditional marketing generates attention.

Axiom builds the system that turns attention into customers.

We don't believe business owners need more dashboards filled with vanity metrics.

content.raw:
Stop Running Ads. Start Running a Revenue System.

We turn paid traffic into booked revenue using systems not guesswork.

Book Your Revenue Systems Audit

Built by operators. Deployed in real businesses. Measured by revenue

How It Works

Clarity removes friction.

      What the audit covers

  • A clear breakdown of where leads are leaking (ads, site, or follow-up)

  • A review of your current traffic, funnel, and booking flow

  • Identification of high-impact fixes vs. low-ROI busywork

  • A simple prioritized action plan (what to fix first, second, third)

  • Honest feedback on what’s worth scaling — and what’s not

Audit

We identify exactly where leads and revenue are leaking.

Build

We install the site, ads, automation, and tracking.

Scale

We optimize what works and compound results month over month.

We Don’t Sell Marketing. We Install Revenue Infrastructure.

Axiom Systems

Axiom Systems builds and installs the full revenue operating stack behind high-ticket experience and service businesses — from paid traffic to booked calls to automation — so demand flows in without chaos.

We don’t run random ads.
We don’t sell tactics.
We install systems operators rely on.

Whether you need immediate inbound demand or a scale-ready revenue engine, every engagement begins with diagnosis — not guesswork.

👉 All Axiom clients begin with a paid Revenue Systems Audit.

Our Revenue Systems

We deploy different levels of infrastructure depending on where your business is today.
Implementation is recommended only after your Revenue Systems Audit.

AXIOM Launch™

(For operators who need inbound leads now)

AXIOM Launch is designed for small and growing operators who need consistent inbound demand without committing to a full revenue system upfront.

This is not a “set it and forget it” ad package.
This is a controlled entry point into paid acquisition.

Includes:

  • Conversion-optimized landing page

  • Google Ads or Meta Ads (single channel)

  • Call & form tracking

  • Lead capture and routing

  • Monthly performance reporting

This system delivers real inbound leads without long-term lock-in.

Investment varies based on market and competition.
Implementation is quoted only after a Revenue Systems Audit.

AXIOM Platinum™

(For operators who want to scale)

AXIOM Platinum is our complete Revenue Operating System built for businesses ready to scale past word-of-mouth, referrals, and marketplace dependence.

This is not marketing.
This is the infrastructure behind predictable growth.

Includes:

  • Google Ads & Meta Ads

  • Funnels and conversion systems

  • Booking engine integration

  • CRM and lead tracking

  • Automated SMS & email follow-up

  • Retargeting & abandoned booking recovery

  • Revenue dashboards & analytics

  • Continuous optimization and system tuning

AXIOM Platinum turns demand into bookings — automatically.

Investment varies based on business size, margins, and growth targets.
Implementation begins only after a Revenue Systems Audit.

Which System Is Right for You?

AXIOM Launch™ is the ideal starting point for operators building consistent inbound demand. As acquisition becomes predictable, Platinum adds the automation, recovery, and tracking infrastructure required to scale.

Established operators move directly into AXIOM Platinum™ to scale with confidence and control.

We don’t upsell.
We deploy what makes sense.

The Revenue Systems Audit

(Required for all new clients)

Every Axiom engagement begins with a paid Revenue Systems Audit.

This is not a sales call.

During the audit, we map:

  • Your current acquisition and booking funnel

  • Where revenue is leaking

  • What system would increase bookings

  • Whether Axiom is the right partner to implement it

If we’re a fit, we’ll outline next steps.
If not, you’ll still leave with clarity and direction.

We’re Not a Fit If:

  • You’re looking for cheap marketing or quick hacks

  • You want one-off tactics instead of systems

  • Your business is under $10,000/month in revenue

  • You don’t have an active advertising budget

  • You’re not the decision-maker

  • You want to “test” marketing without committing to implementation

  • You’re unwilling to track calls, booked revenue, and show-up rates

Axiom Systems is built for operators who want predictable growth — not experiments.

Why Axiom Systems

Axiom Systems was built by real operators running six-figure experience and service businesses — not marketers selling theory.

Every system we deploy for clients is infrastructure we already trust with our own revenue.

No fluff.
No vanity metrics.
Just systems that work.

Book the Revenue Systems Audit ($175)

One-time audit. No long-term commitment required.

We’re not a fit if: • You’re looking for cheap marketing • You want one-off tactics • You’re under $10k/month in revenue • You’re not the decision maker

Axiom Systems

Axiom Systems builds and installs the full revenue operating stack behind high-ticket experience and service businesses — from paid traffic to booked calls to automation — so demand flows in without chaos.

We don’t run random ads.
We don’t sell tactics.
We install systems operators rely on.

Whether you need immediate inbound demand or a scale-ready revenue engine, every engagement begins with diagnosis — not guesswork.

👉 All Axiom clients begin with a paid Revenue Systems Audit.

Our Revenue Systems

We deploy different levels of infrastructure depending on where your business is today.
Implementation is recommended only after your Revenue Systems Audit.

AXIOM Launch™

(For operators who need inbound leads now)

AXIOM Launch is designed for small and growing operators who need consistent inbound demand without committing to a full revenue system upfront.

This is not a “set it and forget it” ad package.
This is a controlled entry point into paid acquisition.

Includes:

  • Conversion-optimized landing page

  • Google Ads or Meta Ads (single channel)

  • Call & form tracking

  • Lead capture and routing

  • Monthly performance reporting

This system delivers real inbound leads without long-term lock-in.

Investment varies based on market and competition.
Implementation is quoted only after a Revenue Systems Audit.

AXIOM Platinum™

(For operators who want to scale)

AXIOM Platinum is our complete Revenue Operating System built for businesses ready to scale past word-of-mouth, referrals, and marketplace dependence.

This is not marketing.
This is the infrastructure behind predictable growth.

Includes:

  • Google Ads & Meta Ads

  • Funnels and conversion systems

  • Booking engine integration

  • CRM and lead tracking

  • Automated SMS & email follow-up

  • Retargeting & abandoned booking recovery

  • Revenue dashboards & analytics

  • Continuous optimization and system tuning

AXIOM Platinum turns demand into bookings — automatically.

Investment varies based on business size, margins, and growth targets.
Implementation begins only after a Revenue Systems Audit.

Which System Is Right for You?

AXIOM Launch™ is the ideal starting point for operators building consistent inbound demand. As acquisition becomes predictable, Platinum adds the automation, recovery, and tracking infrastructure required to scale.

Established operators move directly into AXIOM Platinum™ to scale with confidence and control.

We don’t upsell.
We deploy what makes sense.

The Revenue Systems Audit

(Required for all new clients)

Every Axiom engagement begins with a paid Revenue Systems Audit.

This is not a sales call.

During the audit, we map:

  • Your current acquisition and booking funnel

  • Where revenue is leaking

  • What system would increase bookings

  • Whether Axiom is the right partner to implement it

If we’re a fit, we’ll outline next steps.
If not, you’ll still leave with clarity and direction.

We’re Not a Fit If:

  • You’re looking for cheap marketing or quick hacks

  • You want one-off tactics instead of systems

  • Your business is under $10,000/month in revenue

  • You don’t have an active advertising budget

  • You’re not the decision-maker

  • You want to “test” marketing without committing to implementation

  • You’re unwilling to track calls, booked revenue, and show-up rates

Axiom Systems is built for operators who want predictable growth — not experiments.

Why Axiom Systems

Axiom Systems was built by real operators running six-figure experience and service businesses — not marketers selling theory.

Every system we deploy for clients is infrastructure we already trust with our own revenue.

No fluff.
No vanity metrics.
Just systems that work.

WE BUILD REVENUE SYSTEMS
THAT TURN CLICKS INTO CUSTOMERS.

Paid Ads. Landing Pages. AI Automation. Lead Follow-Up. Booking Systems.

One connected system built to generate, capture, and convert demand.


Turn Demand Into Booked Revenue.

Book My Free Breakdown

Bookings Secured

Appointments and reservations flow straight into your calendar.

Leads Captured

Every visitor and inquiry is tracked, stored, and ready for follow-up.

Revenue Tracked

See exactly which ads, pages, and calls turn into real money.

Follow-Up Automated

Missed calls, abandoned bookings, and leads get contacted instantly.

These are the same systems we use to run our own tour and service companies every day.

+47% conversion rate

Built for Operators, Not Influencers

REVENUE SYSTEMS FOR HIGH-TICKET SERVICE & EXPERIENCE BUSINESSES

Tours • Watersports • Marine • Home Services • Local Service Businesses

Real customers not vanity metrics.

We created this for owners who have dealt with missed calls, half-filled calendars, and money wasted on ads that never turned into bookings.

If you sell high-ticket experiences or services, this system is built to help you turn demand into reliable, predictable revenue.

Running tours and managing bookings in real time

Customers booked and managed through the same system we install

We install and manage the complete revenue engine behind your business from ads to bookings to automation so customers flow in without you babysitting it.

Axiom Systems includes:

• Google Ads & Meta Ads
• Conversion-optimized landing pages
• Booking engine integration
• CRM & lead tracking
• Automated SMS & email follow-up
• Retargeting & abandoned booking recovery
• Revenue dashboards & analytics

Built by Real Operators, Not Marketers

Axiom Systems was built by Michael Hinkle, founder of a six-figure watersports and service business in Florida.

These systems weren’t invented in a boardroom — they were built to run real operations: handling bookings, leads, follow-ups, and ad spend in one of the most competitive tourist markets in the U.S.

Now that same revenue infrastructure is available to other operators who want scale without chaos.

Want More Booked Customers Without More Chaos?

Start with a Free Revenue Breakdown.
I’ll identify where bookings are leaking and map the fastest path to more booked revenue.

We'll identify:

✓ Where leads are leaking
✓ Where ad spend is being wasted
✓ Where automation could recover revenue
✓ Whether Axiom can help

Book My Free Breakdown
